parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which is clearly under an Examples/SampleApp path. The other lives in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift'. Both are anonymous type-alias-other declarations (name is empty string) with no fields, so there is no shared structural content to consolidate. The name collision is coincidental — a sample-app debug HUD independently aliasing the same nested type name as a production debug-metrics provider does not constitute actionable duplication.
